items.name: Vampir Köylü
items.description: A multiplayer browser game built around night and day phases, different roles, and shared decisions.
highlights: I wanted friends to join one room and play with hidden roles. What players can do and see changes as the game progresses.

The lobby and role assignment lead to night actions, day voting, and result tracking. Roles such as doctor, detective, and hunter introduce different rules. Each phase needs a consistent transition to the next.

I separated role assignment, night resolution, and win conditions into focused responsibilities. Public player state stays separate from hidden role information. This keeps the interface simple and makes individual rules easier to verify.
